name: Taco Bell
description: Follow Taco Bell, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Taco Bell first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Lettuce supplier for Taco Bell investigated as possible source for cyclosporiasis outbreak
changes.summary: The FDA has identified a single supplier of iceberg lettuce from Mexico as the possible source of the cyclosporiasis outbreak that has sickened thousands of people, a source says. Taco Bell uses that supplier in five states where people have gotten sick. Ash-har Quraishi reports.

changes.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak traced to lettuce from Mexico used by Taco Bell
changes.summary: A lettuce supplier to fast-food giant Taco Bell has been linked to a nationwide cyclosporiasis outbreak that has sickened thousands of people, the CDC said.

changes.title: Taylor Farms Lettuce at Taco Bell Linked to Stomach Bug Outbreak
changes.summary: The Food and Drug Administration is investigating a potential connection to iceberg lettuce supplied to Taco Bell by produce giant Taylor Farms as the possible source of the cyclosporiasis outbreak that has sickened thousands across 34 states. changes.title: Cyclospora Investigation Turns to Farms in Mexico
changes.summary: The F.D.A. is planning to inspect farms and a lettuce shredding facility to determine how lettuce supplied by the produce company Taylor Farms to Taco Bell became contaminated and where it was shipped.

changes.title: Iceberg lettuce eyed in parasite outbreak
changes.summary: The FDA is investigating iceberg lettuce supplied to Taco Bell by Taylor Farms as a potential source for the cyclosporiasis outbreak in five midwestern states. It's a parasite-borne illness triggering severe cramps and diarrhea. NBC News' Anne Thompson reports.

changes.title: Cyclospora Linked to Taylor Farms Lettuce Sent to Taco Bell
changes.summary: Federal officials worked with Michigan investigators to trace the outbreak to iceberg lettuce, which may also have gone to other vendors.
